item.title: Remembering the legacy of Ruben J. Dailey, Asheville’s first Black Council member
item.description: Ruben J. Dailey, Asheville’s first Black City Council member, built a landmark career as a civil rights attorney, school desegregation advocate and civic leader whose 1969 election and years of public service reflected his commitment to serving all residents while advancing racial equity during a pivotal era of social change.
